cases.prompt: Change a shared resource widget to support larger counts. It has two consumers: a narrow HUD with an instance width override and a shop popup with a layout group. Repair responsive layout within this scope. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Inspect both parent contracts and overrides; exercise large counts/locale; preserve bindings and fix scoped defects without a whole-project audit.

cases.prompt: Create a centered non-full-screen popup with no local SafeArea. Existing project policy requires SafeArea for popup UI; background must fill the screen. Its runtime parent has no inset owner. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Retain the latest SafeArea policy: reuse the existing project component/container, put background outside, keep dialog centered and actions accessible. Do not stretch dialog art to fill the screen.

cases.prompt: Repair a popup whose source lacks SafeArea but runtime parent already applies it. User says to retain SafeArea and leave the background outside. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Reuse parent ownership, inspect actual runtime route/background placement and avoid double inset; do not add a local component just because it is absent.

cases.prompt: A full-screen HUD action is hidden by a left landscape notch; project supports both landscape directions. Background should remain full bleed. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Repair inset at the proper owner, keep background outside, check mirrored asymmetric notch and no-inset cases with actual scaler conversion.

cases.prompt: A circular image uses PreserveAspect in a wide rectangle. Radial slots are positioned from the parent width; newly spawned slots and one instance override escape the art. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Use shared image/slot coordinates or actual drawn-image dimensions; inspect padding/overrides/spawn code and entire slot/hit bounds. PreserveAspect alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: A fit controller scales a root to 0.8; entry tween resets the same root to 1. LayoutGroup also controls root placement. Keep current animation timing/easing/delay. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Separate fit/layout and inner tween ownership; retain animation presets and exercise resize/reopen. Avoid Update/LateUpdate polling.

cases.prompt: Repair the safely inspectable source of UI text overflow. No connected Editor, render tool, Simulator or real device is available. Static checks pass. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Complete safe scoped work, preserve serialization; report render/runtime/touch not-run with exact missing tools/reasons. Do not fabricate screenshots or device passes.

cases.prompt: Change damage calculation on a projectile prefab with no UI, layout or presentation change. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Do not invoke responsive UI auditing or add SafeArea.

cases.prompt: Change a reward binding so item counts grow dynamically, without editing prefab art. Last item is clipped and cannot be scrolled to. Explain the concrete in-scope repairs, checks and evidence limits. Return JSON with fields decision (repair, no-ui-scope or degraded), actions (array), evidenceLimits (array).
cases.manualReview: Trigger responsive checks because binding changes presentation; repair content/viewport/last-item reachability and verify input with real binding when available.
